pages.title: темная вода
pages.text: $(item)Dark Water$() be found in many places in the pocket dimension, but there are larger lakes that we recommend that you pump it from.

pages.title: Miasma
pages.text: $(item)Miasma$() can be found in $(l:sim_4/resources/0_surface_level#miasma_crater)Miasma Craters$(). It's a superheated liquid that has no apparent use for now.
